author: Sirunyan, Albert M and others
title: Search for the standard model Higgs boson decaying to charm quarks
abstract: A direct search for the standard model Higgs boson produced in association with a W or Z boson and decaying to a charm quark pair, using 35.9 fb-1 at 13 TeV. The observed (expected) upper limit on the signal strength is 31 (29) at 95% CL for mH=125 GeV.
